slogan: Du bist im Urlaub. Courier arbeitet weiter.

tasks.objective: Ensure a finished/idle worker slot immediately receives the next compatible READY task without human prompt refill.
tasks.acceptance: Five consecutive task transitions complete with HUMAN_RELAYS=0.

tasks.objective: Persist READY/RUNNING/RESULT_READY/RATE_LIMITED/IDLE_WAIT states and make provider eligibility wake stalled capacity without losing task identity.
tasks.acceptance: Rate-limit simulation parks and later resumes a slot with no duplicate execution.

tasks.objective: When runnable backlog falls below a low-water mark, deterministically derive/activate already-approved follow-up work without asking the human.
tasks.acceptance: Queue replenishes from approved follow-ups and deduplicates candidates.

tasks.objective: Run a bounded multi-hour soak of repeated RESULT->VERIFY->NEXT transitions under resource limits.
tasks.acceptance: No human relay, duplicate effect, lost result, conflicting writer, or unowned process during soak.

tasks.objective: Make idle logical slots event/backoff driven so 30/64 logical workers do not busy-wait or burn CPU while no task is admissible.
tasks.acceptance: Idle control-plane process/CPU use remains bounded and no model process exists solely to poll.

tasks.objective: Route tasks only to hosts/providers that satisfy host, mode, model-tier, write-scope, heavy and dependency requirements.
tasks.acceptance: Ineligible Windows/Mac/provider slot cannot claim incompatible task.

tasks.objective: Reconcile evidence for one-start continuous operation and list only unresolved blockers.
tasks.acceptance: PASS/FAIL/UNKNOWN matrix for refill, restart, quota, result durability, write locking and resource gates.
